high_level_description: The image features a man in formal attire, likely a government official or lawyer, standing in front of an American flag and a backdrop that includes the seal of the Department of Justice (DOJ). The man is wearing a dark suit, white shirt, and patterned tie. He appears to be speaking or addressing an audience, as suggested by his posture and the context of the setting. The background prominently displays the DOJ seal, which includes an eagle with outstretched wings, a shield, and the Latin phrase "Qui pro domino justitia sequitur," meaning "He who serves justice for his lord.
